mapper.select: SELECT output, parsed::text AS parsed FROM chat_tool_replays WHERE session_id = CAST(#{sessionId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND tool_name = #{tool, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND arguments = CAST(#{arguments, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_tool_replays(session_id, tool_name, arguments, output, parsed) VALUES ( CAST(#{sessionId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), #{tool, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{arguments, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{output, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, CAST(#{parsed, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) ) ON CONFLICT (session_id, tool_name, arguments) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO chat_messages(session_id, role, content, reasoning, tool_name, arguments, parsed) VALUES ( CAST(#{sessionId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), #{role, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{reasoning, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{tool, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(NULLIF(#{arguments, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, '') AS jsonb), CAST(NULLIF(#{parsed, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, '') AS jsonb) )
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_sessions SET last_trace = CAST(#{trace, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} AS jsonb), updated_at = now() WHERE id = CAST(#{sessionId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)
mapper.select: SELECT pending_confirmation::text FROM chat_sessions WHERE id = CAST(#{sessionId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_sessions SET pending_confirmation = CAST(#{pending, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), updated_at = now() WHERE id = CAST(#{sessionId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)
UPDATE chat_sessions SET pending_confirmation = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = CAST(#{sessionId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)

UPDATE chat_sessions SET consumed_confirmation_nonces = consumed_confirmation_nonces || jsonb_build_array(#{nonce, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), updated_at = now() WHERE id = CAST(#{sessionId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND NOT (consumed_confirmation_nonces @> jsonb_build_array(#{nonce, jdbcType=VARCHAR}))
